messages:
maria: Quick note from a customer onboarding call — their engineers saw `500` in the quickstart UI with no helpful context and assumed the SDK was broken. We should make the sample app show better handling and logging.

aj: Do we have an example of the raw envelope that caused confusion? Browser console or backend logs would help.

maria: From the front-end network tab (sanitized):
```json
{
  "status": 500,
  "error": "InternalServerError",
  "message": "handler panic",
  "trace_id": "abcd-1234"
}
```

sam: Problem: runtime turned a model-level error into generic 500 and dropped machine code. Suggestion: enforce an `error_code` string and an optional `retry_after` int in every non-2xx response. Also include `trace_id` for debugging. SDKs then map those to typed exceptions.

zoe: For onboarding UX we should show two things in the sample app: 1) a dev console panel showing the telemetry-friendly `message` + `trace_id`, and 2) a user-friendly banner guided by `error_code`. Eg `auth_expired` -> "Sign in again to reconnect".

ryan: Mapping proposal (concise):
401 -> AuthExpiredError (retryable: false, hint: reauth)
403 -> PermissionError (retryable: false)
429 -> ThrottledError (retryable: true, retry_after present)
502/503/504 -> BackendTransient (retryable: true, backoff)
model_oom/model_timeout -> ModelExecutionError (retryable: false, hint: try smaller prompt)

ci-bot: infra-bot: PR 4408 created -> adds error_code + retry_after + trace_id to runtime responses and preserves model codes. https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4408

aj: Gateway note: don't swallow model error_code when proxying; pass through as `upstream_error_code` if schema differences exist. Also add middleware to normalize old responses for backward compatibility.

sam: SDK API ergonomics idea: throw instances of `RedwoodError` subclasses with these flat props: `name`, `code`, `message`, `retryable` (bool), `retryAfter` (seconds or null), `traceId`, `raw` (stringified payload). Example JS behavior in sample app:
```js
try {
  await client.chat.complete(...)
} catch (e) {
  // quick heuristics shipped in sample app
  if (e.code === 'auth_expired') showSignIn();
  else if (e.retryable) scheduleRetry(e.retryAfter || 1);
  else console.error('Non-retryable failure, trace:', e.traceId);
}
```

zoe: Add a small snippet for Go and Rust SDKs in the sample app README so infra teams see cross-language parity. For example: Golang error type `type RedwoodError struct { Code string; Retryable bool; RetryAfter int; TraceID string; Raw string }`.

maria: On telemetry: log `error_code`, `trace_id`, and `status`, not the raw human `message`. The `message` field is for logs and devs only. Also mark which codes should trigger alerts (e.g., model_oom spikes).

ryan: Tests: add an e2e that injects an upstream `model_timeout` and asserts SDK surfaces `ModelExecutionError` and sample app shows "Try again with smaller input" copy.

sam: Ownership / next steps:
- runtime PR 4408 (ci-bot) -> land and deploy to staging (aj to review)
- SDKs: introduce base `RedwoodError` and language parity examples (sam to implement: JS/Python/Go/Rust)
- sample app: show dev console + user banner + mapping table (zoe to update README)
- docs: central error code reference + localization guide (aj to author)

maria: Can we aim to get SDK pieces merged next sprint and sample app updated before the next onboarding cohort? Also add a short migration note for teams currently checking `status` only.

ci-bot: heads-up: runtime PR 4408 scheduled to merge to staging on 2026-03-26T04:00:00Z.

zoe: I'll draft the sample app banner text and include a tiny mapping JSON for locales. Will paste before EOD once PR is in staging.

maria: thanks all. tagging @sam @aj for SDK+e2e follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
